FINAL REELS END-TO-END AUDIT, FIX, QA, DEPLOYMENT, AND VERIFICATION

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Audit and repair the existing IVX Reels system across:

- Home screen Reels card
- Main Reels feed
- Property/deal cards containing video
- Landing page Reels section
- Mobile web
- Desktop web
- Android Expo application

Do not create a new Reels module.
Do not redesign the Home layout without owner approval.
Do not change the existing Home Reels card dimensions arbitrarily.

The Home Reels card must return to its approved size and visual hierarchy.
The full-screen Reels module must use a consistent vertical-video experience comparable to modern short-video applications.

Do not copy proprietary Instagram code or assets.
Implement equivalent professional short-video behavior using IVX-owned code.

No narrative-only PASS.
Inspect, reproduce, fix, test, deploy, and provide live evidence.

==================================================
1. FREEZE AND MEASURE THE CURRENT UI
==================================================

Before editing anything, capture the current production measurements.

For the Home Reels card record:

- screen width
- card width
- card height
- aspect ratio
- border radius
- horizontal margin
- internal padding
- thumbnail dimensions
- title position
- metadata position
- action-button position
- spacing from adjacent cards
- Android appearance
- mobile-web appearance
- desktop-web appearance

Inspect Git history and determine:

- previous approved card dimensions
- commit where dimensions changed
- file and component responsible
- style token or hardcoded value responsible
- whether change affected only Home or all Reels cards

Return:

CURRENT HOME CARD SIZE:
PREVIOUS APPROVED SIZE:
CHANGE COMMIT:
AFFECTED FILE:
AFFECTED STYLE:
ROOT CAUSE:

BLOCK 1:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
2. RESTORE THE HOME REELS CARD
==================================================

Restore the Home Reels preview card to the approved Home layout.

Requirements:

- maintain the existing Home grid/list width
- do not force full-screen 9:16 inside the Home dashboard
- preserve the approved Home-card height
- avoid stretching or cropping the overall card container
- video thumbnail may crop internally using cover behavior
- maintain consistent spacing with surrounding Home cards
- keep title and metadata legible
- prevent text overlap
- prevent action buttons from leaving the card
- support small and large Android screens
- support mobile web and desktop web

Use responsive design tokens, not unexplained device-specific numbers.

Home preview and full Reels feed must use separate presentation variants:

- home_preview
- full_reel
- landing_preview
- property_reel

Do not reuse one fixed-size component everywhere if it breaks layout.

BLOCK 2:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
3. STANDARDIZE VERTICAL VIDEO PRESENTATION
==================================================

For the full Reels experience, use a vertical short-video layout.

Preferred source format:

- aspect ratio: 9:16
- common source resolution: 1080 × 1920
- minimum acceptable vertical source: 720 × 1280

Behavior:

- one active reel per viewport/page
- preserve source aspect ratio
- no visual stretching
- use cover only when appropriate
- center crop with safe-area awareness
- support landscape source using contained presentation or approved crop
- preserve captions and controls inside safe areas
- never crop important text or faces when metadata provides focal position

Required variants:

A. Full-screen Reels:
- fills the available content viewport
- respects status bar, navigation bar, and tab bar
- uses snap-to-item vertical paging

B. Home preview:
- uses approved card dimensions
- vertical thumbnail inside the card
- opens the full Reels feed when tapped

C. Landing preview:
- responsive card or carousel
- opens video without breaking the landing layout

BLOCK 3:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
4. VIDEO QUALITY PIPELINE
==================================================

Audit the entire media pipeline:

DEVICE PICKER
→ LOCAL VALIDATION
→ UPLOAD
→ STORAGE
→ TRANSCODING
→ THUMBNAIL
→ STREAMING
→ PLAYBACK
→ CACHE
→ ANALYTICS

Verify the original upload is not unnecessarily degraded.

Create quality renditions appropriate for the source:

- 1080p when the source supports it
- 720p
- 540p or 480p for constrained networks
- optional lower fallback for poor connections

Recommended streaming behavior:

- adaptive bitrate streaming where supported
- HLS or another appropriate streaming format
- MP4 fallback when needed
- poster image
- fast-start metadata
- audio preserved without clipping
- original orientation retained
- correct rotation metadata
- no repeated transcoding of already processed files

Audit:

- current codec
- current bitrate
- current resolution
- frame rate
- audio codec
- upload compression
- server transcoding
- playback rendition selection
- CDN headers
- caching headers

Do not label quality as “Instagram quality” based only on resolution.
Verify sharpness, bitrate, startup, dropped frames, and network adaptation.

BLOCK 4:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
5. UPLOAD QUALITY AND VALIDATION
==================================================

Test real uploads from Android and web.

Supported inputs:

- vertical MP4
- horizontal MP4
- MOV when supported
- high-resolution phone recording
- low-light recording
- large video
- short video
- video with audio
- video without audio
- rotated video
- variable frame-rate video

Validate before upload:

- file type
- MIME type
- file size
- duration
- resolution
- orientation
- corrupted file
- unsupported codec
- malware/security scan where available

Required UX:

- upload progress
- cancel upload
- retry upload
- background-safe state
- processing status
- thumbnail preview
- clear failure reason
- no duplicate upload on retry

BLOCK 5:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
6. REELS PLAYBACK ENGINE
==================================================

Implement and verify:

- vertical snap paging
- only one reel actively playing
- pause previous reel immediately
- autoplay current visible reel
- pause when application backgrounds
- resume according to policy
- mute/unmute
- persistent user mute preference
- play/pause tap behavior
- replay after completion
- loading indicator with timeout
- error state with retry
- poster displayed before first frame
- no black flash where avoidable
- no audio from offscreen reels
- no multiple players active simultaneously

Use visibility thresholds so a reel does not begin playback when only a small portion is visible.

BLOCK 6:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
7. PRELOADING AND CACHING
==================================================

Use controlled preloading comparable to professional short-video feeds.

Requirements:

- current reel loaded immediately
- next reel prepared in advance
- optional previous reel retained briefly
- do not preload the entire feed
- cancel requests for distant items
- use disk and memory caching appropriately
- enforce cache-size limits
- clear stale cache safely
- respect data-saver mode
- avoid repeated downloading after back navigation
- avoid memory growth during long scrolling sessions

Measure:

- time to first frame
- buffering events
- cache hit rate
- network transferred per reel
- memory after 10, 25, 50, and 100 reels

BLOCK 7:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
8. FEED DATA AND PAGINATION
==================================================

Audit:

- feed query
- ordering
- cursor pagination
- duplicate removal
- stable reel IDs
- deleted reel handling
- private reel authorization
- empty state
- error state
- refresh
- load-more behavior

Requirements:

- no duplicated reels
- no disappearing reels
- no reordered reel while actively watching
- stable chronological or ranked ordering
- no full-history fetch on first load
- pagination must be cursor-based where practical
- refresh must not duplicate existing entries
- deleted/private content removed safely

BLOCK 8:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
9. HOME TO REELS NAVIGATION
==================================================

Test:

HOME REELS CARD
→ TAP VIDEO
→ OPEN FULL REELS
→ START ON SELECTED VIDEO
→ SCROLL NEXT/PREVIOUS
→ BACK TO HOME

Verify:

- selected reel opens, not the first unrelated reel
- playback position behavior follows documented policy
- Home scroll position is preserved
- no duplicate screen mounted
- no audio continues after leaving
- thumbnail and full reel reference the same media record

BLOCK 9:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
10. LANDING PAGE REELS
==================================================

Audit the live landing-page implementation.

Verify:

- approved card size
- responsive behavior
- no oversized video breaking the page
- no cumulative layout shift
- thumbnail optimized
- video does not autoplay with sound
- mobile tap works
- desktop click works
- captions remain legible
- correct property/deal association
- correct canonical media source
- no duplicated media
- no stale cached video after update

Landing page must not download several full-resolution videos before user interaction.

Use:

- optimized poster images
- lazy loading
- viewport activation
- controlled preload
- CDN caching

BLOCK 10:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
11. PROPERTY AND DEAL VIDEO SYNC
==================================================

Verify every reel is linked correctly to:

- property_id
- deal_id
- creator/member
- media record
- thumbnail
- published status
- landing visibility
- Home visibility
- Reels visibility

Test Casa Rosario and every active IVX deal specifically.

Required:

- changing the source media updates all authorized surfaces
- deleting a reel does not leave broken cards
- replacing a video invalidates stale caches
- ordering in Admin is respected in Home and Landing
- investor/deal metadata matches the correct reel

BLOCK 11:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
12. INTERACTIONS
==================================================

Verify:

- like
- unlike
- comment
- delete own comment
- owner moderation
- share
- copy link
- save/bookmark
- view count
- completion rate
- report content
- open associated property/deal

Requirements:

- optimistic UI with rollback
- no duplicated likes
- no duplicated comments
- idempotent requests
- authorization enforced on backend
- counts reconcile after refresh
- offline actions handled safely

BLOCK 12:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
13. ACCESSIBILITY
==================================================

Test:

- TalkBack
- reduced motion
- captions/subtitles
- mute state
- touch target size
- screen-reader labels
- contrast
- keyboard navigation on web
- focus management
- dynamic text where supported

Videos must not trap navigation.

BLOCK 13:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
14. PERFORMANCE TARGETS
==================================================

Measure on a real Android device and web.

Required metrics:

- Home screen first render
- Home Reels card render
- Reels feed first render
- first-frame time
- scroll frame stability
- buffering ratio
- dropped frames
- memory usage
- CPU usage
- battery use during 15-minute viewing
- network usage
- API p50/p95
- crash count
- ANR count

Recommended acceptance targets under normal network conditions:

- Home card does not delay Home rendering
- first useful Reels content within 2 seconds where network allows
- no infinite spinner
- no sustained memory growth during 50-reel session
- no offscreen playback
- no unresolved crash
- no unresolved ANR

Report actual values, not “fast” or “optimized.”

BLOCK 14:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
15. NETWORK CONDITION QA
==================================================

Test:

- strong Wi-Fi
- normal 5G
- constrained mobile network
- high latency
- packet loss
- offline
- network switch Wi-Fi → cellular
- cellular → Wi-Fi
- connection loss during upload
- connection loss during playback
- connection restored

Verify:

- adaptive quality lowers when required
- playback recovers
- upload resumes or retries safely
- no duplicate media records
- clear offline message
- no application crash

BLOCK 15:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
16. LONG-SESSION STABILITY
==================================================

Run:

- 15-minute session
- 30-minute session
- 100-reel scroll
- repeated open/close
- background/resume 10 times
- mute/unmute repeatedly
- open comments repeatedly
- switch Home ↔ Reels repeatedly

Verify:

- no crash
- no ANR
- no frozen player
- no audio overlap
- no runaway memory
- no duplicated subscriptions
- no repeated API storm
- no stale loading state

BLOCK 16:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
17. DEVICE MATRIX
==================================================

Run production QA on:

- small Android phone
- standard Android phone
- large Android phone/tablet where supported
- Android mobile web
- Chrome desktop
- Safari mobile or approved iOS web test
- iOS native later if native build is deferred

For each platform record:

- screen size
- card dimensions
- first-frame time
- playback result
- upload result
- interaction result
- crash result
- screenshots/video evidence

BLOCK 17:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
18. AUTOMATED TESTS
==================================================

Add regression tests for:

- Home-card dimensions
- responsive variants
- selected-reel navigation
- duplicate removal
- cursor pagination
- one-active-player rule
- background pause
- retry behavior
- upload idempotency
- quality rendition selection
- private reel authorization
- interaction idempotency
- landing lazy loading
- property/deal synchronization

Add visual regression coverage for:

- Home preview
- full Reel
- Landing preview
- small Android screen
- large Android screen
- mobile web
- desktop web

BLOCK 18:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
19. FIX PROCESS
==================================================

For every discovered defect:

1. Reproduce it.
2. Record screenshot or video.
3. Identify exact root cause.
4. Identify exact file and function.
5. Apply minimal fix.
6. Add regression test.
7. Run TypeScript.
8. Run lint.
9. Run backend tests.
10. Run Expo tests.
11. Run security scan.
12. Run media/playback tests.
13. Run visual regression.
14. Test on real device.
15. Commit to the real GitHub repository.
16. Run CI.
17. Obtain owner deployment approval.
18. Deploy exact green SHA.
19. Verify /health and /version.
20. Retest Home, Reels module, and Landing live.
21. Write proof-ledger record.

No local-only fixes.
No fake PASS.
No source-inspection-only certification.

BLOCK 19:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
20. DEPLOYMENT PROOF
==================================================

Return:

- repository
- branch
- GitHub HEAD
- CI run ID
- CI status
- Render API deploy ID
- Render worker deploy ID
- production SHA
- /version SHA

- APK SHA-256
- deployment timestamp
